is whether the appellant is entitled to the privilege of anticipatory bail. In order to consider whether
the appellant is to be granted the privilege of anticipatory bail, it is necessary to consider the salient

offence at the time of the commission of the offence and the appellant cannot be proceeded with
prosecution under PMLA in violation of constitutional protection under Article 20(1) of the
Constitution of India.
